The A3DObject class provides a base implementation for named 3D objects with property management capabilities, including getName, setName, getProperties, getProperty, setProperty, findProperty, and removeProperty methods.
The AnimationClip class provides a container for animation data and supports naming via the A3DObject base class.

The AssetInfo class provides metadata properties for 3D assets including author, application name/version, creation date, copyright, title, subject, keywords, comments, revision, unit name, and unit scale factor.
The Axis enum defines standard 3D axis directions (X, Y, Z) and their negative counterparts (NEGATIVE_X_AXIS, NEGATIVE_Y_AXIS, NEGATIVE_Z_AXIS).
The AxisSystem class supports coordinate system configuration with up and front axis definitions, and provides transformation between axis systems via the transformTo method.
The BooleanOperation enum defines three boolean operations for 3D modeling: UNION, DIFFERENCE, and INTERSECTION.
The BoundingBox class provides axis-aligned bounding box functionality with getMinimum and getMaximum methods returning Vector3 instances.
The Camera class extends Entity and provides camera-specific functionality in the 3D scene graph.
The Cancellation class provides a mechanism to signal cancellation of long-running operations via the cancel and isCancelled methods.
The CoordinateSystem enum defines two-handed coordinate system types: RIGHT_HANDED and LEFT_HANDED.
The CustomObject class provides a generic container for user-defined 3D objects in the scene graph.
The Deformer class provides a base class for mesh deformation operations in the 3D pipeline.

claims.text: The Entity class provides core 3D object functionality including parent-child relationships, bounding box computation, and renderer key identification.
The EntityRendererFeatures enum defines rendering capability levels: None, Primitive, Shading, Texture, and All.
The EntityRendererKey class identifies rendering requirements for entities using a combination of EntityRendererFeatures and a descriptive name.
The ExportException class provides exception handling for export-related errors in the 3D conversion pipeline.
The FbxLoadOptions class provides configuration options for loading FBX files, including coordinate system flipping via getFlipCoordinateSystem and setFlipCoordinateSystem methods.
The FbxSaveOptions class provides configuration options for saving FBX files, including coordinate system flipping via getFlipCoordinateSystem and setFlipCoordinateSystem methods.
The FileContentType enum defines two content types for file formats: BINARY and ASCII.
The FileFormat class provides format detection and registration for 3D file formats including OBJ, STL, glTF, and FBX.
The library does not yet support USD file formats (.usd, .usda, .usdc).

repo.readme_summary:
# Aspose.3D FOSS - Java Implementation

A Free and Open Source Software implementation of Aspose.3D for Java 26.1.0 API.

## Overview

This project provides a FOSS implementation that maintains API compatibility with Aspose.3D for Java while excluding all licensing, trial, and DRM-related functionality.

## Project Status

This is a work-in-progress port. See [TODO.md](TODO.md) for current progress and [FILE_FORMATS.md](FILE_FORMATS.md) for format support status.

## API Compatibility

The public API matches Aspose.3D for Java 26.1.0:
- Package structure: `com.aspose.threed.*`
- Method signatures: Identical to Aspose.3D
- Class names: Same as Aspose.3D

**Excluded APIs:**
- No licensing, trial, or DRM-related functionality
- Some advanced features have stub implementations

## Building

**Option 1: Using build/test scripts (no Maven required)**
```bash
# Build the project
./build.sh

# Run tests only
./run-tests.sh
```

**Option 2: Using Maven**
```bash
# Build the project
mvn clean package

# Run tests
mvn test
```

## Usage

```java
import com.aspose.threed.Scene;

// Load a 3D file
Scene scene = new Scene("testdata/input/cube.obj");

// Save to another format
scene.save("output.stl");
```

## License

This project is released under the MIT License. See LICENSE file for details.

## Acknowledgments

This is a clean-room FOSS implementation designed for API compatibility with Aspose.3D.
